what_to_detect: A static ability's contribution sets an affected object's name (the contribution's name field is set), as copying another object's full text does.
near_miss: A continuous record whose acting static applies to the board but contributes no name.

what_to_detect: A token-creating resolution creates a token whose creature subtypes (token_created characteristics.types) differ from the subtype its token script defines (token_script_id), because a text-changing effect replaced the creature type the creating ability uses for both the token's type and name.
near_miss: A token-creating resolution whose created tokens carry exactly the subtypes their token script defines.
